官方三个主源页面（iec.html、eligibility.html、eligi: None of the three official pages (iec.html, eligibility.html, eligibility-by-country.html) lists a language test requirement — zero hits for IELTS or language test — so no language threshold is recorded here. The earlier 「IELTS, 24 months」 had no official basis and has been removed. Whether an individual partner country adds its own language condition is a matter for its bilateral arrangement with Canada; confirm with the Canadian office handling that country.
中国大陆不在协议内，无配额。官方主源只按类别列出参与国/地区，不公布各参与方的年: Mainland China is not a partner country, so there is no quota. The official pages list participating countries and regions by category but publish no per-partner annual quota — the Hong Kong and Taiwan numbers are settled in annual consultations and are not disclosed on canada.ca.
开放式工签，可为任意雇主工作，无需雇主担保。停留期 12 个月为中国香港、中国台: An open work permit: you may work for any employer with no sponsorship. The 12-month stay is the official ceiling for the two eligible passports, Hong Kong and Taiwan (official wording: up to 12 months); other partner countries can reach 24 months. None of the three official pages sets a study-duration cap (study appears only in the TEER credential context), and the earlier max_study_months=6 had no basis and was removed. An open work permit imposes no explicit study cap, but the purpose of entry must still be primarily holiday and work.
无犯罪记录证明、体检、语言考试三项已从资格条件中移除：官方三个主源页面检索 cr: Police checks, medical exams and language tests were removed from the eligibility conditions: searching the three official pages returns zero hits for criminal, police, medical exam and IELTS, and the nearest wording is the admissibility condition 「not be inadmissible to Canada」. That removal rests on negative evidence (zero hits), which is not the same as the government saying these are not needed — a visa officer can still request further documents in an individual case.
§20 第 2 款明文要求生计保障：`Die Erteilung einer A: Section 20(2) requires secured subsistence in so many words: `Die Erteilung einer Aufenthaltserlaubnis nach Absatz 1 setzt die Lebensunterhaltssicherung voraus.` In practice this is shown with savings, a parental guarantee letter, or a signed employment contract. There is no nationwide figure — each foreigners office decides case by case.
⚠️ 官方页未提及在读/毕业时间要求，也未设学历门槛；该门槛不在公开规则里，由各: ⚠️ The official page mentions no enrolled/recent-graduate timing rule and sets no academic threshold; that bar lives with the national committees and the individual role at recruitment time rather than in published rules. The claim that master's students must stay enrolled and bachelor's graduates must apply within two months comes from a third-party summary page with no counterpart on the official site, and is no longer used.
⚠️ 官方页未要求强制保险；「AIESEC 强制购买保险」出自第三方概述页，官方: ⚠️ The official page requires no compulsory insurance; the claim that AIESEC forces you to buy a policy comes from a third-party summary page with no counterpart on the official site, and is no longer used. Whether insurance is needed depends on the visa rules of the receiving country.
⚠️ 官方页不公布审理时长——选拔由各国分会滚动进行，时长取决于具体岗位的招募周: ⚠️ The official page publishes no processing time — national committees recruit on a rolling basis and the duration depends on the specific role's recruitment cycle, not on a uniform process.
要求因国家委员会而异。IAESTE Germany 明文要求英语水平证明且不得超: Requirements differ by national committee. IAESTE Germany explicitly requires proof of English no more than three years old, accepting UNIcert, Cambridge, IELTS, ISE, TOEFL, TOEIC, PTE Academic, onSET, OLS, Duolingo, or 「at least two full semesters taught entirely in English」; applicants from the US, Canada (outside Quebec), the UK, Ireland, New Zealand and Australia are exempt. Whether the China committee applies the same rule is not stated on the official page — confirm with IAESTE China. **The official list sets no CEFR level, so the earlier 「requires C1 or C2」 has no counterpart and is no longer used.**
无统一名额上限。官方口径为 1948 年至今累计派出 374,000+ 名学生、: No global quota. The official figures are cumulative — 374,000+ students, 2,500+ volunteers and 3,000+ receiving organisations since 1948 — and no single-year number is published (「about 4,000 a year」 is an old record with no official basis and is no longer used). Fees work the same way: IAESTE sets no global price, and registration and participation fees are set by each national committee, so ask the committee handling your application.
⚠️ 关键信息：爱尔兰 WHA 仅对签约国家/地区开放，官方名单为安道尔、阿根廷: ⚠️ Key point: Ireland's WHA is open only to partner countries and regions — Andorra, Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chile, Hong Kong, Japan, New Zealand, South Korea, the US and Taiwan. Mainland China is not on the list. Hong Kong's quota is not published (the ISD page says only Places are limited); Taiwan's is 400 a year (ISD wording: an annual quota of 400 WHAs, with the first 400 eligible applications taken for the 2027 round).
须证明 `you have enough money to support yo: You must show `you have enough money to support yourself without working or help from public funds`, or have a relative or friend funding you and providing accommodation, and you must be able to pay for your return or onward journey. The government sets no fixed amount — only the ability to support yourself — and asks for six months of bank statements or payslips as evidence.
22 CFR 62.30 未设资金门槛。但须自付项目费、机票与前期食宿，且项目费: 22 CFR 62.30 sets no funds threshold. You do pay the programme fee, flights and initial living costs yourself, and the programme fee is set by each sponsor rather than published by the State Department, so ask your chosen sponsor for a quote. Pay must match that of US workers in the same role.
